# THIS FILE IS AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED BY CARGO
#
# When uploading crates to the registry Cargo will automatically
# "normalize" Cargo.toml files for maximal compatibility
# with all versions of Cargo and also rewrite `path` dependencies
# to registry (e.g., crates.io) dependencies.
#
# If you are reading this file be aware that the original Cargo.toml
# will likely look very different (and much more reasonable).
# See Cargo.toml.orig for the original contents.

[package]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.98.0"
name = "ejm-rightkit-fs"
version = "0.4.4-ejm.1"
build = false
include = [
    "src/**",
    "tests/**",
    "README.md",
    "FORK.md",
    "rightkit-fs.provenance.json",
    "rightkit-fs.source.json",
    "upstream.patch",
    "LICENSE-MIT",
    "LICENSE-APACHE",
]
autolib = false
autobins = false
autoexamples = false
autotests = false
autobenches = false
description = "Maintained rightkit-fs fork with direct permanent-file creation and strict handle privacy checks."
readme = "README.md"
keywords = [
    "filesystem",
    "atomic-write",
    "file-lock",
    "symlink",
    "permissions",
]
categories = ["filesystem"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/ejmlabs/ejm-rightkit-fs"

[package.metadata.rightkit]
continuous = false
continuous_reason = "sleep: bounded retry delay for a transient rename or sharing violation (atomic.rs, RetryPolicy attempts) and lock acquisition poll bounded by LockOptions.timeout (lock.rs); no thread, task, timer, listener, watcher or growing memory (reviewed 2026-10-11); resident-static: the thread_local cells in src/atomic.rs are per-thread fault-injection and sync-count seams inside the testing and test-seams features (testing refuses to compile in a release build, test-seams is off in production), each a fixed-size Cell or a short Vec of steps recorded only while a test arms it; the COUNTER there is a single AtomicU64 (reviewed 2026-10-17)"

[features]
app-dirs = ["fs"]
blake3 = ["dep:blake3"]
default = []
digest = ["dep:sha2"]
fs = [
    "dep:libc",
    "dep:thiserror",
]
json = [
    "lock",
    "dep:serde",
    "dep:serde_json",
]
lock = ["fs"]
test-mode = [
    "app-dirs",
    "dep:serde",
    "dep:serde_json",
]
test-seams = ["fs"]
testing = [
    "fs",
    "test-seams",
]
zip = []

[lib]
name = "rightkit_fs"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "rightkit-clonefile"
path = "src/bin/rightkit-clonefile.rs"
required-features = ["json"]

[[bin]]
name = "rightkit-swap"
path = "src/bin/rightkit-swap.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "acl_macos"
path = "tests/acl_macos.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_checked"
path = "tests/atomic_checked.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_checked_sync"
path = "tests/atomic_checked_sync.rs"
required-features = ["testing"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_dacl_windows"
path = "tests/atomic_dacl_windows.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_digest"
path = "tests/atomic_digest.rs"
required-features = [
    "fs",
    "digest",
]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_exclusive"
path = "tests/atomic_exclusive.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_exclusive_nolink"
path = "tests/atomic_exclusive_nolink.rs"
required-features = ["testing"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_namespace"
path = "tests/atomic_namespace.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_options"
path = "tests/atomic_options.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_privacy"
path = "tests/atomic_privacy.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_publish"
path = "tests/atomic_publish.rs"
required-features = ["testing"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_seams"
path = "tests/atomic_seams.rs"
required-features = ["test-seams"]

[[test]]
name = "atomic_testing"
path = "tests/atomic_testing.rs"
required-features = ["testing"]

[[test]]
name = "blake3_verified"
path = "tests/blake3_verified.rs"
required-features = [
    "fs",
    "blake3",
]

[[test]]
name = "clone"
path = "tests/clone.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "clone_fallback"
path = "tests/clone_fallback.rs"
required-features = ["testing"]

[[test]]
name = "e2e"
path = "tests/e2e.rs"
required-features = ["json"]

[[test]]
name = "lock_alias"
path = "tests/lock_alias.rs"
required-features = ["lock"]

[[test]]
name = "lock_cross_process"
path = "tests/lock_cross_process.rs"
required-features = ["lock"]

[[test]]
name = "lock_owner"
path = "tests/lock_owner.rs"
required-features = ["json"]

[[test]]
name = "lock_reparse"
path = "tests/lock_reparse.rs"
required-features = ["lock"]

[[test]]
name = "lock_spawn"
path = "tests/lock_spawn.rs"
required-features = ["json"]

[[test]]
name = "owner_append"
path = "tests/owner_append.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "owner_executable"
path = "tests/owner_executable.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "owner_report"
path = "tests/owner_report.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "owner_sweep"
path = "tests/owner_sweep.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "owner_verified"
path = "tests/owner_verified.rs"
required-features = [
    "fs",
    "digest",
]

[[test]]
name = "private_keeps_locks"
path = "tests/private_keeps_locks.rs"

[[test]]
name = "publish_file"
path = "tests/publish_file.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "publish_first_free"
path = "tests/publish_first_free.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "state_ancestors"
path = "tests/state_ancestors.rs"
required-features = ["testing"]

[[test]]
name = "state_durability"
path = "tests/state_durability.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "stored_zip"
path = "tests/stored_zip.rs"
required-features = ["zip"]

[[test]]
name = "swap"
path = "tests/swap.rs"
required-features = ["fs"]

[[test]]
name = "trash_windows"
path = "tests/trash_windows.rs"

[dependencies.blake3]
version = "1.8"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.11"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies.tempfile]
version = "3"

[target."cfg(unix)".dependencies.libc]
version = "0.2"
optional = true
